title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about Job Support.

q1.question: What is Job Support?
q1.answer: Job Support is a professional platform that connects employers, job seekers, and support organizations to make the hiring process faster, easier, and more reliable.

q2.question: Is Job Support free to use?
q2.answer: Job Support offers both free and premium plans depending on your needs. Job seekers can start for free, while employers can choose advanced hiring tools.

q3.question: How do I apply for a job?
q3.answer: Simply create a profile, upload your resume, and browse job listings. You can apply directly through the platform in just a few clicks.

q4.question: How can employers post jobs?
q4.answer: Employers can register, create a company profile, and post job openings easily through the employer dashboard.
